title: Correct the keyboard shortcut display and adjustment contract
objective: Align every affected shortcut hint and the ← → keyboard action to exact ±15-minute adjustments while keeping pointer controls, duration bounds, persisted overrides, and 12-hour user-facing time labels consistent. No affected surface displays or applies ±30 minutes.

defect.display: Rail KeysCard rendered the ← → hint as '±30min' while the row steppers and slider already stepped in 15-minute (half-block) increments.
defect.behavior: Queue rowKeydown adjusted ArrowLeft/ArrowRight by BLOCK_STEP (1 block = 30 minutes) on the integer grid via clampBlocks, so the keyboard action disagreed with the ±15 min pointer steppers (a − press at every integer was a no-op and + jumped 30 minutes).
defect.persistence_impact: Keyboard overrides wrote 30-minute-grid values into the same OVERRIDE_SET store the pointer controls use, so the persisted value differed from the pointer contract.

fix.behavior: KeysCard ← → hint changed from '±30min' to '±15min'. No other hint surface was affected.

rowKeydown ArrowLeft/ArrowRight now steps by HALF_BLOCK (0.5 block = exactly 15 minutes) and clamps via clampHalfBlocks, matching the row steppers and slider grid. Unused BLOCK_STEP/clampBlocks imports removed.

unchanged_contracts: MIN_BLOCKS=0 / MAX_BLOCKS=16 duration bounds unchanged; clampHalfBlocks already honored them.
Pointer steppers ('−15 min' / '+15 min' tooltips, '15 minutes less/more' aria labels) and slider step=0.5 already on the half-block grid; untouched.
setOverride → OVERRIDE_SET persistence path untouched; keyboard and pointer now write the same half-block grid.
Internal HH:MM wire format and 12-hour display12h authority (FEEDBACK-12) untouched.
SetupDrawer Mint 'each session is 30min' copy is a Mint session length, not a shortcut hint; out of scope and unchanged.
acceptance_criteria_met: Every affected shortcut hint displays ±15 min and no affected hint displays ±30 min: Rail KeysCard asserts getByText('±15min'), queryByText('±30min') null, and the Keyboard shortcuts section never contains '30min'.
The ← → keyboard action changes the effective value by exactly 15 minutes in both directions: ArrowRight 3 → 3.5 blocks, ArrowLeft 1 → 0.5 blocks, both directions from the same base return to 3.

Pointer controls, duration bounds, and persisted values stay consistent: stepper clicks persist the same half-block override value as the keyboard, slider step equals HALF_BLOCK, ArrowLeft walks 1 → 0.5 → 0 and clamps at 0 and at 16, and ArrowRight from all day lands on 0.5 (15 min), never 1 (30 min).

Focused tests cover display text, both adjustment directions, and boundary behavior: 10 new tests in frontend/src/ui/feedback14.test.tsx (hint text, ArrowRight, ArrowLeft, both-directions, floor walk, all-day ArrowRight, upper-bound clamp, pointer persistence, slider grid, 12-hour labels).
User-facing time labels in the tested surface remain 12-hour: sequenced Queue asserts '10:45 AM', /AM|PM/ present, and no bare HH:MM readout without AM/PM.
